cta.talk: Talk to us about your project

home.audienceCommercialBody: Office buildings, bank branches and retail structures, delivered to specification with engineering supervision throughout. Our completed work includes a bank branch in Limbe, built to a client's own technical review.
home.audienceResidentialBody: A family firm with its name on the building. One engineer accountable from the first site visit to the day the keys change hands, and a written report at every stage in between.
home.servicesTitle: Five services, from the ground up
home.servicesBody: Each one states what it covers and where its boundaries lie, so scope is settled in the first conversation rather than argued over at finishing stage.
home.designsBody: Four residential schemes, from a two-storey duplex to a six-storey apartment block. These are architectural visualisations — drawings of proposed buildings, labelled as such throughout.
home.workBody: Footage from live sites: a slab being poured, a structure in elevation, reinforcement inspected before concrete covers it, and a concrete cube tested to confirm the mix reached its grade.
home.projectsTitle: First Trust Bank and the CCC Building
home.projectsBody: Both in Limbe, on the coast, where salt exposure governs reinforcement cover and the specification of every external fixing.
home.engineerBody: A research Master's in Civil Engineering, DIPET II certification, and more than twenty-five years of practice across five cities in four regions of Cameroon — anglophone and francophone.
home.processTitle: From the first call to the keys
home.processBody: Eleven stages, each setting out what happens and what you provide, so you know where a build stands at any point.
home.citiesBody: Buea, Limbe, Douala, Yaoundé and Bamenda. Each builds differently, and each page sets out the conditions that shape a project there.
home.finalTitle: Tell us what you want to build
home.finalBody: Start with a message or a call, and we will arrange a site visit.

services.title: Our services
services.intro: Five services, covering a project from the soil beneath it through to the day it is handed over. Structural supervision and geotechnical work are offered alongside construction, which means the ground can be tested and the structure checked by the same engineer who is accountable for the build.
services.excludesNote: Stated up front so that scope is clear before work begins.

projects.title: Our work

projects.photographyNote: Photography of both buildings is being arranged. Until it is complete, these pages set out the work rather than illustrate it.

siteWork.intro: Footage taken on live sites. A slab being poured, a structure in elevation, reinforcement laid out before concrete covers it, and a concrete cube tested on a compression machine.

designs.title: Designs
designs.intro: Architectural visualisations of residential schemes — computer drawings of proposed buildings rather than photographs of completed ones. Each is labelled accordingly, and the notes set out what is fixed at design stage and what follows from the plot.
designs.ctaTitle: Interested in a scheme like this?
designs.ctaBody: A visualisation is where a build starts. Send us the one that interests you and we will talk about the plot it has to sit on.

process.title: How a build runs
process.intro: Eleven stages between a first conversation and a set of keys. Each sets out what happens and what you provide. Programme and commercial terms are agreed per project in the written contract at stage six, because they follow from the plot, the design and the season.
process.soilHighlight: We carry out our own soil investigations, so this stage runs within the same programme rather than waiting on a third party.
process.ctaBody: A message or a call. Stage two is a site visit.

about.title: A family firm with its name on the building
about.lede: Nkweya & Sons Constructions is a civil engineering contractor working across five cities in four regions of Cameroon, anglophone and francophone, led by an engineer with a research Master's degree and more than twenty-five years in the trade.
about.positioningBody: A family firm puts its own name above the door. Every building carries that name, and so does every commitment made about it. It is the reason the same engineer who tests the ground also signs off the structure and attends the handover.
about.engineerBio: Nkweya Francis has practised civil engineering for more than twenty-five years, across Buea, Limbe, Douala, Yaoundé and Bamenda — five cities spanning four regions and both working languages of the country. His completed work includes First Trust Bank and the CCC Building, both in Limbe.
about.engineerBioTwo: He holds a Master's degree in Civil Engineering by research and is DIPET II certified. He is on site for the stages that decide a building: the soil investigation, the reinforcement inspection before each pour, and the joint inspection at handover.
about.capabilityBody: Soil investigation, design, construction and supervision are carried out under one accountable engineer. That keeps the sequence intact: the foundation follows the soil report, the structure follows the drawings, and each is checked before the next begins.
about.coverageBody: Five cities across four regions, in both anglophone and francophone Cameroon.
about.ctaBody: Not a call centre, and not a sales team.

contact.title: Get in touch

contact.whatsappBody: The quickest way to reach us, and the one most clients use.
contact.emailBody: For drawings, documents and anything that needs a written record.
contact.nextBody: We establish what you want to build and where, then arrange a site visit. Everything after that follows the eleven stages set out on the process page.

legal.privacyBody: This website sets no cookies, runs no advertising trackers, and does not profile visitors. Your language choice is stored in your own browser and never leaves it. If you contact us, what you send reaches the company directly so that somebody can reply to it, and is used for nothing else.
legal.privacyContact: To ask what is held about you, or to have it deleted, use any of the contact routes on this site.
legal.termsBody: The information on this website is published in good faith and kept current. A quotation is a written document issued after a site visit, and only that document binds.
legal.termsRenders: Images labelled as design visualisations are computer-generated drawings of proposed schemes. They are not photographs of completed buildings and should not be read as a record of work carried out.
